|translation='''Title:''' Magnetic suction duct.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on your Sandcrawler. During your control phase, you may target one character at the same place. Draw destiny. If destiny > the character's ability, “suck up” that character (move it to a related interior Sandcrawler location card or the owner's Used Pile).

'''Lore:'''
“Slurp.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed lore is 「シュポ」.
